run_create_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to convert ASE atoms directories into a finetuning dataset with train and val splits
launch_processing_convert_ase_files: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms files into an ASE database with metadata and logs
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from a training ASE database subset
compute_lin_ref_coefficients: compute linear reference coefficients from atomic numbers and energies using least squares regression
write_ase_db_parallel: write ASE atoms objects with energy and force results to an ASE database file in parallel
